tool_args.rationale: The initial five short-horizon rows cannot distinguish long-timescale adaptation from competing smooth mechanisms at the target horizon. A slow-horizon probe is the most relevant next observation for resolving that ambiguity.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the five-parameter sink-coupled dual-horizon adaptation law now
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Five initial rows are insufficient to identify this coupled five-parameter model reliably, especially with only short horizons and a 22.5 target horizon.
A slow-horizon discriminating observation directly tests the key adaptation/reversal behavior at lower cost.
It is explicitly nuisance data and does not resolve the model's horizon ambiguity.
Current pilot signatures and recalled mechanism evidence favor sink-coupled adaptation; no oscillatory signature supports this alternative.
